entities.summary: Åsmund Kåresson was a renowned Viking Age runemaster who flourished during the first half of the 11th century in Uppland and Gästrikland, Sweden. The early Urnes style is distinctly represented in his art, showcasing the evolution of Scandinavian runestaves. Kåresson's contributions to the field of runology have been extensively studied, with many of his works still displayed in museums today. His art has been interpreted as a reflection of the Viking Age's cultural and artistic identity, with many considering him one of the most influential runemasters of his time. As a result of his work, the Urnes style has had a lasting impact on the development of Scandinavian art and literature.
